people.name: Micaiah
people.line: A prophet who foretold King Ahab's death.

translations.web: Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, I will say what my God says.”
translations.bsb: But Micaiah said, “As surely as the LORD lives, I will speak whatever my God tells me.”
translations.kjv: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.
translations.asv: And Micaiah said, As Jehovah liveth, what my God saith, that will I speak.
